schemes.name: Post-Matric Merit Scholarship
schemes.summary: Annual scholarship for students in Class 11 to postgraduate courses from families with annual income up to Rs 2,50,000. Applications are free and made only through the official portal.
eligibility: Family income up to Rs 2,50,000 per year

schemes.name: Girl Child Higher Education Grant
schemes.summary: One-time grant of Rs 25,000 for girl students entering an undergraduate degree, family income up to Rs 8,00,000. No application fee.
eligibility: First year of an undergraduate degree
Family income up to Rs 8,00,000 per year

schemes.name: Senior Citizen Pension Top-up
schemes.summary: Monthly pension top-up of Rs 1,500 for citizens aged 60 and above with family income below Rs 1,00,000. Free to apply at the official portal or a government service centre.
eligibility: Family income below Rs 1,00,000 per year
